---
title: "Mermaid theme variables"
# bd-sehm2rha (GH #1296): `$mermaid-*` SCSS variables reach the compiled
# `--mermaid-*` custom properties, separately for the light and dark
# stylesheets, so toggling the color scheme recolors diagrams.
format:
  html:
    theme:
      light: [cosmo, theme-variables-light.scss]
      dark: [darkly, theme-variables-dark.scss]
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ["mermaid\\.initialize\\(\\{ startOnLoad: false, themeCSS: \""]
        - []
      ensureCssRegexMatches:
        - ["--mermaid-fg-color:\\s*#123456", "--mermaid-fg-color:\\s*#abcdef"]
        - []
---

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  Alice->>Bob: Hello
```
